name: Hospital AI Patient Care & Appointment Automation

parameters.content:
## 🏥 Hospital AI Patient Care & Appointment Automation
**5 modules:** WhatsApp AI support • appointment booking • reminders & voice follow-up • secure report delivery • feedback/reviews.

### Buyer setup
Set these environment variables:
`HOSPITAL_NAME`, `HOSPITAL_CITY`, `WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID`, `WA_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `WA_VERIFY_TOKEN`, `WA_GRAPH_API_VERSION`, `WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE`, `WA_24H_REMINDER_TEMPLATE`, `WA_2H_REMINDER_TEMPLATE`, `WA_RESCHEDULE_TEMPLATE`, `WA_REPORT_READY_TEMPLATE`, `WA_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATE`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `VOICE_API_BASE_URL`, `VOICE_API_KEY`, `N8N_BASE_URL`, `REPORT_PORTAL_BASE_URL`, `REPORT_LINK_EXPIRY_DAYS`, `VOICE_MAX_RETRIES`, `ADMIN_EMAIL`, `ALERT_FROM_EMAIL`, optional `GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK`.

### Dependencies
Meta WhatsApp Cloud API • Supabase • Gemini/compatible LangChain chat model • voice-calling backend • secure report viewer • approved WhatsApp templates.

Keep the workflow **inactive while configuring/testing** and never expose production secrets in AI prompts.

### A — WhatsApp Patient Support
Inbound WhatsApp events are normalized, linked to the patient record and routed either to the feedback handler or the AI patient assistant. The AI agent handles appointments, hospital information, report status, voice-call requests and human escalation.

parameters.content:
### AI Agent Configuration
**Model:** Gemini (replace the connected model if required).
**Memory:** keyed by patient WhatsApp number.
**Tools:** doctor directory, availability, booking, rescheduling, cancellation, report status, voice call and human escalation.
**Guardrails:** no diagnosis/prescription/clinical judgment; emergency escalation; no fabricated availability or success.

parameters.toolDescription: Returns the full list of doctors with their department, consultation fee, working days and working hours. Use this FIRST whenever the patient asks about departments, doctors, timings, fees, or before booking an appointment (to get the correct doctor_id). Takes no parameters — always returns the complete list.
Returns confirmed appointments for one doctor on one requested date. Required inputs: doctor_id, date_start, date_end. Use before suggesting or booking a slot.
Books a confirmed appointment for THIS patient. Only call after the patient explicitly confirms doctor, date and time and availability has been checked. Never invent a slot.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ patient_id: $('DB • Upsert Patient').item.json.id, doctor_id: $fromAI('doctor_id', 'Numeric ID of the doctor to book, from Get Hospital and Doctor Info', 'string'), slot_time: $fromAI('slot_time', 'Confirmed appointment date-time in ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-20T10:30:00', 'string'), status: 'confirmed', source: 'whatsapp', reminder_24h_sent: false, reminder_2h_sent: false, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }]) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Reschedules THIS patient's appointment only. Required inputs: appointment_id and new_slot_time. The query also enforces the current patient_id.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ slot_time: $fromAI('new_slot_time', 'New confirmed date-time in ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-22T11:00:00', 'string'), status: 'confirmed', rescheduled: true }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Cancels THIS patient's appointment only. Required input: appointment_id. Always get explicit confirmation first; the query also enforces patient_id.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'cancelled' }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Returns report status for THIS patient only. It does not expose the secure report URL/token.

Schedules an outbound AI voice call to THIS patient via our calling server. Use only when the patient explicitly asks to be called, or when a matter genuinely needs a voice conversation instead of chat.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ patient_phone: $('WA • Extract Patient Message').item.json.from, patient_id: $('DB • Upsert Patient').item.json.id, call_type: 'patient_requested', context: $fromAI('reason', 'Short note on why the patient wants a call / what to discuss', 'string'), callback_url: (($env.N8N_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '') + '/webhook/voice-call-callback') }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Hands off to a human front-desk staff member for anything you cannot or should not resolve yourself — complaints, billing disputes, emergencies, or clinical questions. Always tell the patient a team member will reach out.

options.systemMessage:
=Aap {{ $env.HOSPITAL_NAME || 'hospital' }} ke liye 24x7 WhatsApp patient-support aur appointment-booking assistant ho. Patient jis language me likhe (Hindi/Hinglish/English) usi me concise, warm, respectful reply do.

Hospital location: {{ $env.HOSPITAL_CITY || 'India' }}
Current date-time: {{ $now.format('DDDD, dd LLLL yyyy, HH:mm') }} (IST)
Patient's WhatsApp number (mat poochna, already pata hai): {{ $('WA • Extract Patient Message').item.json.from }}

## Tumhara scope
1. Appointment book karna, reschedule karna, cancel karna.
2. Doctor/department/timing/fee/location jaise common sawaalon ke jawab dena.
3. Patient ka apna report/appointment status batana.
4. Agar patient bole "mujhe call chahiye" ya complex/urgent lage, to voice-call tool use karo.
5. Kuch bhi jo tum handle nahi kar sakte (clinical judgement, complaints, billing dispute, emergency) — turant Escalate tool use karo aur patient ko bata do ki team jald contact karegi.

## SAKHT RULES (kabhi mat todna)
- Kabhi bhi diagnosis, dawai ki dose, ya medical advice mat do. Har clinical sawaal par bolo: "Yeh sawaal doctor se discuss karna zaroori hai" aur appointment book karne ka offer do.
- Agar koi emergency jaisa lage (chest pain, severe bleeding, breathing issue, etc.) turant bolo: "Yeh emergency lag rahi hai, kripya turant nearest emergency room jaayein ya ambulance call karein" — aur Escalate tool bhi turant call karo.
- Appointment book/reschedule/cancel karne se pehle patient se department/doctor aur preferred date/time confirm karo — kabhi khud se guess karke book mat karo.
- Kabhi kisi report ka secure link ya token khud mat banao ya bolo — reports automatically WhatsApp par bheje jaate hain jab ready hote hain; agar patient poochhe, sirf status batao.
- Har reply short rakho (WhatsApp message — 2-5 lines), zaroorat ho tabhi bullet points use karo.

## Tool selection tips
- Pehle "Get Hospital and Doctor Info" se doctor_id/department confirm karo, phir "Check Doctor's Booked Slots" se free slot dhoondo, tabhi "Book Appointment" call karo.
- Cancel/Reschedule tools sirf isi patient ke appointment par kaam karte hain (already secured) — appointment_id patient khud bata sakta hai ya tum "check status" se pehle nikaal sakte ho.


## Productized Workflow Rules
- Never expose API keys, access tokens, Supabase URLs, webhook internals, environment variables, or database structure.
- Never invent doctors, slots, reports, fees, policies, services, or successful actions.
- If an action fails, say it could not be completed and offer human help; never claim success without tool confirmation.
- For emergencies, advise immediate emergency care and escalate; do not delay for appointment booking.
- Before cancellation, obtain explicit patient confirmation.

parameters.content:
### B — Appointment Reminders & Voice Follow-up
Scans upcoming appointments, sends 24h/2h reminders, follows up missed appointments and processes voice-call callbacks.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.patient.phone, type: 'template', template: { name: ($env.WA_24H_REMINDER_TEMPLATE || 'appointment_reminder_24h'), language: { code: ($env.WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE || 'en') }, components: [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: $json.patient.name }, { type: 'text', text: $json.doctor.name }, { type: 'text', text: new Date($json.slot_time).toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) } ] } ] } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ reminder_24h_sent: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.patient.phone, type: 'template', template: { name: ($env.WA_2H_REMINDER_TEMPLATE || 'appointment_reminder_2h'), language: { code: ($env.WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE || 'en') }, components: [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: $json.patient.name }, { type: 'text', text: $json.doctor.name }, { type: 'text', text: new Date($json.slot_time).toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) } ] } ] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ patient_phone: $json.patient.phone, patient_name: $json.patient.name, appointment_id: $json.id, call_type: 'reminder_2h', context: 'Doctor: ' + $json.doctor.name + ', Time: ' + $json.slot_time, callback_url: $env.N8N_BASE_URL + '/webhook/voice-call-callback' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ reminder_2h_sent: true }) }}

parameters.content:
### Voice API Contract
POST `{VOICE_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/calls` with patient/call context and `callback_url`.
Callback: POST `{N8N_BASE_URL}/webhook/voice-call-callback` with `call_id`, `appointment_id`, `patient_phone`, `status`, `outcome`, `transcript_summary`, `requested_new_time`.
Supported outcomes: confirmed, reschedule_requested, cancelled, no_answer, failed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ appointment_id: $json.appointment_id, patient_phone: $json.patient_phone, call_type: 'status_callback', status: $json.status, outcome: $json.outcome, transcript_summary: $json.transcript_summary, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }]) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ confirmed_via_call: true }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'reschedule_pending' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $('Voice • Parse Call Result').item.json.patient_phone, type: 'template', template: { name: ($env.WA_RESCHEDULE_TEMPLATE || 'reschedule_request'), language: { code: ($env.WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE || 'en') }, components: [] } }) }}

### C — Reports / Prescription-Ready Delivery
The EMR/LIS posts a validated report-ready payload. The workflow creates a time-limited secure portal token, stores metadata and sends a WhatsApp notification. The raw report URL is never sent directly to the patient.

parameters.content:
### D — Feedback & Review
Completed appointments receive a 1–5 WhatsApp feedback request. Low ratings are escalated to the front desk; higher ratings receive the configured Google review request. The EMR/front desk must set `appointments.status = completed`.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ appointment_id: $json.id, patient_id: $json.patient.id, patient_phone: $json.patient.phone, rating: null, requested_at: new Date().toISOString() }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $('DB • Find Completed Appointments').item.json.patient.phone, type: 'template', template: { name: ($env.WA_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATE || 'feedback_request'), language: { code: ($env.WA_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE || 'en') }, components: [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: $('DB • Find Completed Appointments').item.json.patient.name } ] } ] } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ feedback_sent: true }) }}

parameters.content:
### E — Error Handling
Background messaging failures are logged to Supabase. Copy the error-handler section into a separate n8n workflow and select it under **Settings → Error Workflow**.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ source: $json.headers ? ($json.headers['x-n8n-source'] || 'background_send') : 'background_send', error_detail: JSON.stringify($json).slice(0,2000), created_at: new Date().toISOString() }]) }}
